Messages.Body:
Hi all
Just a quick scenario:
Vamp A has a soul gem and a skill card, he also posseses some random
usable once per turn card text. If that vamp is burned in my minon
phase and is replaced by the same vampire am I free to use the card
text again? I assume so as it is not "the same minion" but another
copy. Is this true or not? and if not why not?
Thanks
Sutekh_23

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It is true. The new vampire has not used his "random usable once per
turn" text yet.
